title: Shunted
html_source:
To shunt is the act or process of turning aside or moving to an alternate course.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Shunting is an electrical term as the power is shunted around the motors when the tram is stopped. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WhEZo06Zd0
